description: Which databases this build's migrator may migrate, and up to which migration. Read by dist/scripts/migrate.js before anything is applied (ADR-002). Changing this file requires Architecture review (CODEOWNERS).

discovery.reason: Legacy Discovery production database: its authorized sequence ends at 0023 until the cutover to `beeside`; after the cutover it is never migrated again.

fa4_staging.reason: Internal FA4 staging database (dev project): mirrors the legacy Discovery schema.

beeside.reason: Canonical shared database (Discovery + Precision): receives the full sequence.
